# Pixel Bowling Score Sheet

An offline, single-player bowling score sheet made with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It has no packages, network requests, external assets, or server code.

## Run

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. The page works locally without an internet connection.

## Play

Choose a pin count with the labeled 0–10 buttons. The sheet marks strikes with **X** and spares with **/**, and fills each running frame total as its bonus rolls are entered. The final score appears after the tenth frame is complete. Use **Undo roll** to remove the last entry or **New game** to reset.

You can also enter a roll with the number keys 0–9; Backspace undoes the last roll. Buttons disable pin counts that would exceed the remaining pins in a frame.
